 Photos: Doug McDermott through the years
 Doug McDermott scores two of his 26 points in Creighton's win over San Jose State in the first round of the CBI tournament at the Qwest Center Omaha on March 15, 2011. He set records for most points (581) scored by a Missouri Valley Conference freshman and a Creighton newcomer. He was also named MVC Freshman of the Year and first team all-MVC.
 MARK DAVIS, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Creighton's Doug McDermott catches T.J. Robinson's forearm with his nose while driving to the basket in the second half of a basketball game against Long Beach State. The Bluejays played the 49ers at the CenturyLink Center on Feb. 18, 2012. 
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Doug McDermott and the Bluejays get ready to take the court for warmups on March 3, 2012. Creighton was playing the Evansville Purple Aces in a semifinal game of the State Farm MVC Tournament in St. Louis, Missouri. 
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Creighton's Doug McDermott, No. 3, takes a shot in the Bluejays' 79-72 win over Illinois State on Jan. 2, 2013. McDermott finished with 15 points, pushing his career scoring total to 1,703 points.
 ALYSSA SCHUKAR,THE WORLD-HERALD
 Creighton's Doug McDermott grabs a second-half rebound from Bradley's Walt Lemon Jr. (25) as Creighton hosted Drake at the CenturyLink Center on Feb. 2, 2013. 
 MARK DAVIS, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Doug McDermott (3) and Grant Gibbs (10) react to a call late in the game against Wichita State University on Jan. 15, 2013. Creighton played Wichita State at the Koch Arena in Wichita, Kan.
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Creighton's Doug McDermott scored 25 points, but the Bluejays lost to Wichita State 67-64 on Jan. 15, 2013.
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Doug McDermott goes over Wichita State 's Cleanthony Early for two of his 18 points in the first half on 7 of 7 shooting. McDermott finished with 41 points at the CenturyLink Center Omaha on March 2, 2013.
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Creighton forward Doug McDermott was averaging 22.4 points and 7.6 rebounds in the 2013 season. He was a finalist for the Lou Henson Award.
 Doug McDermott, No. 3, celebrates with Austin Chatman, No. 1, and Jahenns Manigat, No. 12, during Creighton's victory over Wichita State on March 2, 2013. That victory gave the Bluejays the top seed for the Missouri Valley Conference tournament.
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Losing to Doug McDermott, left, and Creighton on March 2, 2013, put extra pressure on coach Gregg Marshall and Wichita State in the upcoming Missouri Valley Conference tournament in St. Louis. Marshall wanted a good showing in the conference tournament to ensure his team's NCAA hopes. But Creighton went on to become Missouri Valley champs.
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Creighton's Doug McDermott scored 39 points, passing Larry Bird on the NCAA's all-time scoring chart to move into 13th place. The Bluejays beat Villanova 101-80 at CenturyLink Center Omaha on Feb. 16, 2014.
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Creighton's Doug McDermott tries a fade-away jumper against St. John's JaKarr Sampson on Jan. 28, 2014.
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Creighton has a statue of All-American Doug McDermott. So does his family. In 2014, the third statue of McDermott went up for auction, with the proceeds going to the Goodfellows charity.
 KENT SIEVERS, THE WORLD-HERALD
 Doug McDermott leaves the court for the last time as a Creighton Bluejay after CU lost to Baylor in the West Regional of the NCAA tourney . McDermott said he had no regrets about his decision to return for his senior season, despite the painful finale. “At halftime, we were all really positive that we could get back in it.''
 MATT MILLER, THE WORLD-HERALD
